BLOCKING_ASSUMPTIONS: The permutation keeps each component's marginal count inside YEAR x SHOCK_SIZE_STRATUM.
Overlapping trailing feature windows remain in the dependence description.
Volatility clustering remains in the dependence description.
Multiple shocks inside one market episode remain in the dependence description.
Common ETH and BTC shocks remain in the dependence description.
A time gap between events is not treated as independence.
COMPONENTS: One-sided taker burst: 15m taker-buy share of quote volume outside the frozen trailing-90d percentile band
Trade fragmentation: 15m trade count per unit quote volume above the trailing-30d 95th percentile
Cross-asset synchrony: ETH 15m return of the same sign as the BTC shock and beyond 3 trailing-30d ETH sigma
Intrabar overshoot: the 15m extreme in the shock direction exceeds the 15m close by at least 40 percent of the 15m high-low range
COUNTERFACTUAL_CLASS: Permute the ALL4 joint label within YEAR x SHOCK_SIZE_STRATUM while preserving individual component main effects, their marginal counts, and the frozen nuisance structure.
ERA_INVARIANCE_RATIONALE: No BitMEX replication is claimed. The prospective Binance surface stays separate from discovery.
EVENT_OR_STATE_DEFINITION: Primary cell only: BTC 15m absolute log(close/open) beyond 3 trailing-30d sigma, taker-buy quote share outside the trailing-90d p1-p99 band, trade count per quote volume above the trailing-30d 95th percentile, ETH 15m return of the same sign beyond 3 trailing-30d ETH sigma, and intrabar overshoot of at least 40 percent of the 15m range. The nominal sample keeps the first eligible shock in each 6h cluster.

EXPECTED_EFFECT.RATIONALE: An incremental effect smaller than 0.20 outcome SD is not large enough to justify carrying a four-component forced-flow state into the Signalbot decision/context layer. This is a planning magnitude. It is not an observed effect.

FALSIFIABLE_CLAIM: The joint coefficient lies inside the permutation null. Alternatively, it has the opposite sign, meaning slower decay, in at least 3 of 5 years.
MECHANISM: Liquidation engines send price-insensitive market orders that are finite in quantity. Once the inventory of margin-deficient positions is exhausted, the forcing stops. A shock produced by forced flow should therefore lose volatility faster than an equal-size shock driven by discretionary information. The forced-flow state is identified only when several independent footprints occur together.

NOMINAL_OBSERVATION_COUNT_CONSTRUCTION.EXCLUSION_RULE: Bars without a complete trailing window, bars inside 6h after a kept shock, and every month from 2025-01 onward.
NOMINAL_OBSERVATION_COUNT_CONSTRUCTION.INCLUSION_RULE: BTC 15m bar with a complete trailing 90d history whose absolute log(close/open) exceeds 3 trailing-30d sigma, then the first such bar in each 6h cluster.

PRIMARY_CELLS.ESTIMAND: standardized incremental coefficient of FORCED_FLOW_ALL4_JOINT on RV_DECAY beyond component main effects and nuisance baseline
PRIMARY_CELLS.HORIZON: post window from T+1h through T+7h (POST_WINDOW_H = 6h)

QUALITATIVE_DEPENDENCE_SOURCES: multiple shocks inside the same market episode
